head: """Matching difuso de nombres (fold + score), extraído de tools.py (split del
archivo-dios, 2026-06-19). `_fold` normaliza (casefold + sin acentos + solo
alfanumérico); `_score` puntúa la similitud query<->candidato para resolver apps

cicla con tools.py (que lo re-exporta para sus métodos y para app_resolver).
from __future__ import annotations
import re
import unicodedata
def _fold(text: str) -> str:
text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text.casefold())
text = "".join(ch for ch in text if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", text).strip()
# Connective words that must NOT count as a meaningful name overlap (else
# "League of Legends" ~ "Sea of Thieves" via "of"). ES + EN.
_APP_NAME_STOPWORDS = frozenset({
"of", "the", "a", "an", "and", "in", "on", "for", "to",
"de", "del", "la", "el", "los", "las", "y", "e", "en", "un", "una",
def _score(query: str, candidate: str) -> int:
q = _fold(query)
c = _fold(candidate)
if not q or not c:
return 0
if q == c:
return 100
if c.startswith(q):
return 90

# nombre corto del .exe, misma app. Candidato >=4 chars y query de 1 palabra
# (evita "ch"->chrome y "hola mundo..."->app espuria).

return 88

head: """Captura de pantalla rápida (mss, in-process ~30-200ms).
Exportado LITERAL de gemma4_agent/tools_pkg/screenshot_fast.py: DPI-aware
per-monitor v2, modo 'active' = el monitor de la ventana en foco (la clave
del fix de alucinación del 2026-06-07: describir 3840x2160 multi-monitor
alucina; el monitor activo no), 'primary' elegido por origen (0,0) (mss no
garantiza que monitors[1] sea el primario).
from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Optional
def _active_rect() -> Optional[tuple]:
"""Rect (left,top,w,h) del monitor que contiene la ventana en foco."""
try:
import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes
u = ctypes.windll.user32
hwnd = u.GetForegroundWindow()
if not hwnd:
return None
hmon = u.MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, 2)  # MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST
if not hmon:
return None
class _RECT(ctypes.Structure):
_fields_ = [("left", wintypes.LONG), ("top", wintypes.LONG),
("right", wintypes.LONG), ("bottom", wintypes.LONG)]
class _MONINFO(ctypes.Structure):
_fields_ = [("cbSize", wintypes.DWORD), ("rcMonitor", _RECT),
("rcWork", _RECT), ("dwFlags", wintypes.DWORD)]
mi = _MONINFO()
mi.cbSize = ctypes.sizeof(_MONINFO)
if not u.GetMonitorInfoW(hmon, ctypes.byref(mi)):
return None
r = mi.rcMonitor
return (int(r.left), int(r.top), int(r.right - r.left), int(r.bottom - r.top))
